original_test_intent: Verify that the specified Mellanox InfiniBand port physically displays the vendor-defined solid-yellow Physical Up indication under the approved fabric/link condition.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the mapped port, observes and photographs its LED under the defined fabric state, and compares color/pattern with the exact hardware legend; software state is corroboration only.
manual_activity: Qualified operator observes and photographs the exact physical IB port LED and judges it against the approved solid-yellow Physical Up legend.
required_inputs: Vendor LED legend for the installed NIC/firmware/hardware revision
Approved Physical Up fabric/link condition and expected ibstat state
Qualified operator with safe access and photo/video capture
Protected evidence location and optional secure MST/ibstat access
safety_requirements: Verify exact port and fabric condition before observation
Do not change fabric configuration, unplug cables or toggle ports merely to force color
Stop on unsafe access, wrong port, damaged connector, ambiguous color or fabric impact
Preserve time-correlated images and optional complete state evidence
Do not infer physical color from ibstat or MST
agent_execution_scope: Correlate operator timestamps and store physical evidence
Do not claim vision, manipulate topology or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Review physical result and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies no remote command can prove physical LED color.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command substitutes for observation; optional untruncated MST/ibstat output may corroborate the declared Physical Up condition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical LED check, solid-yellow Physical Up criterion and 10/10 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture labeled physical evidence tied to stable port identity and the exact approved fabric state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, state, safety and evidence requirements.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No visual coverage is replaced by electronic inference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera white balance and vendor-specific coding may obscure yellow/steady behavior; ambiguity requires operator/engineer disposition.

project_override_considerations: The exact NIC revision and firmware LED legend govern; generic Mellanox behavior is not assumed.
expected_evidence: Optional complete MST/ibstat/link evidence at the same time

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree that direct physical observation is authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is manual rather than inherently blocked when the operator, visible port, legend and safe fabric condition are available.

review_improvement: Makes the solid-yellow observation identity- and state-specific without falsely automating a physical fact.
independent_technical_reasoning: IB state tools can show LinkUp or Active, but neither encodes the emitted LED color or proves which physical aperture an operator saw. The acceptance therefore needs direct imagery tied to stable HCA/port identity and contemporaneous fabric state.
